kxtre01.title: Storytime: The Wrong Coffee Order
kxtre01.caption:
Gemini grabbed the wrong coffee and both cups said SAM. Neither of them is Sam.
Two hours of soup talk later, the swap was on purpose. Who in your chat has a meet-cute this chaotic?

kxtre02.title: Expectation vs Reality: The Whole First Date
kxtre02.caption:
Expectation: a smooth first date. Reality: Taurus tripped on the doormat and wore the same sweater as Capricorn.
Guess which side was having more fun by the third wave goodbye.

kxtre03.title: Plot Twist: "Can We Talk Later?"
kxtre03.caption:
"Can we talk later?" at 9 A.M. Cancer read it forty times and folded every towel in the house.
The call at 6:58 was not what the group chat predicted. Who spirals like this in your chat?

kxtre04.title: Main Character Moment: The Scarf Incident
kxtre04.caption:
Leo scored their own walk home like a movie, theme song and all. Then the scarf got stuck on a fence.
The best scene was the one nobody planned. Which sign narrates their own life?

kxtre05.title: GRWM: The Date I Almost Cancelled
kxtre05.caption:
Get ready with Virgo: two outfits, one checklist, and a cancel text typed and never sent.
Then Aries admitted they were nervous too. Ever almost bailed on something good?

kxtre06.title: A Day in the Life: The Read Receipt
kxtre06.caption:
A day in the life of a little Read label, who knew the secret all along.
Read at 2:14, reply at 9:12, and the reply was a whole paragraph. How long do you wait before spiralling?

kxtre07.title: POV: You're the Friend Who Gives Advice
kxtre07.caption:
POV: everyone texts you for advice and your own draft has been sitting unsent for three weeks.
Then Pisces asks who gives you advice. Tag the friend who needs to hear that.

kxtre08.title: Me at 2 PM vs Me at 2 AM: Missing an Ex
kxtre08.caption:
2 PM Scorpio is so over it. 2 AM Scorpio has the sad playlist on and a draft that starts "hey. random but."
What 2 AM Scorpio does next is the real glow-up.

kxtre09.title: Wait For It: Capricorn's Friend File
kxtre09.caption:
Capricorn built a spreadsheet about the friends, with a column called "hard month?" Very suspicious.
Wait for row 12. Which friend in your chat shows love in spreadsheets?
